description: This PHP class defines a form processor for managing personal project data, including fields like contract name, NIF, birth date, phone, entity name, PayPal, and bank account. It utilizes Symfony form components and custom form types, and implements validation and save logic.

classes.name: ProjectPersonalForm
classes.description: A form processor class for handling user input related to personal project details, with validation and save capabilities.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns validation constraints for a specific field, requiring non-blank validation for 'phone' if full validation is enabled.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Initializes form fields with labels, constraints, and attributes, including contract details, contact info, and payment options.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves form data into user and account models, throwing exceptions on errors.
